0022600154.text: The Celtics (4-1, on a four-game winning streak) are 4-0 at home and 0-1 on the road, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic, one game back, and 3rd in the East as they visit the Orlando Magic (2-3, 0-2 at home), who are 4th in the Southeast, half a game back, and 9th in the East. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and has Mitchell Robinson listed as day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The Celtics won the last meeting 113-108 in Boston on April 12, 2026, and won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, with no games between the teams yet this season.
